---
title: "Exercise - Analysis in Quarto"
author: "Eleanor Gillett"
---
I am calculating the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain (the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus) in a human, pig and mouse.

Human:
```{r}
human_genes <- sum(180,83,57,110)
print (human_genes)
```


```{r}
pig_genes <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(pig_genes)

```


```{r}
mouse_genes <- sum(55,185,60,98)
print(mouse_genes)

```
The species with the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression is human.
